task_title: Floor 4 arena HUD and feedback surfaces

plan_review.notes: Adversarial review considered: Alt A reuse existing encounter widgets; rejected because Floor 4 needs a combined act clock/wave pip/break-summary/Winner Circle panel and existing widgets do not expose that state. Alt B make the projection sim-owned; rejected for this slice because a pure shared read-only model gives deterministic reuse without expanding gameplay state. Alt C fold Floor 4 into the encounter layout resolver; deferred because the measured HudUI offset keeps this surgical and tests cover bounds. Resolved blockers by rendering all six summary lines and making probes assert renderedSummary parity; resolved data-authority concern by deriving wavesPerAct from the manifest; accepted current real-scene boot plus HUD-lab forced-state split as sufficient deterministic coverage for this slice.

code_review.notes: Round 1: gpt-5.4 raised 2 concerns (cut notice rendering alongside VICTORY LAP once the Headliner is cleared inside the 3s notice window; actBaseline per-act wiring lacked a real sim-driven regression test, only fixture-level coverage) and gemini-3.1-pro-preview independently raised 1 distinct concern (break-summary 'Gold earned' diffed against the live, continuously-mutating playerGold instead of a locked end-of-act snapshot, so it would shrink in real time as the player shopped during the break). All 3 resolved: added `!state.phase.cleared` to the cutNotice guard with a regression test; added a real sim-driven integration test in tests/unit/floor4-arena-director.test.ts driving arenaDirectorSystem through two acts; added a breakGoldSnapshot captured at INTERMISSION entry (src/game/floor4Scenario.ts, src/shared/floor-types.ts, src/shared/floor4-hud.ts) with a regression test proving the lock. Round 2: both models re-reviewed the fixed diff and reported 0 concerns / clean.

multi_model_review.notes: Same round-1/round-2 findings as code_review, viewed under the multi-model + adjudication lens. Adjudicator claude-opus-4.8 independently reviewed the fixed diff (traced determinism, the per-act delta math including the new breakGoldSnapshot lock, cut-notice suppression, real shipped-scene wiring via HudUI.sync()/MainGameScene, layer boundaries, and resource cleanup) and confirmed 0 actionable concerns, noting only one informational (non-defect) coverage nuance: the breakGoldSnapshot lock's real-sim proof point landed with no gold spent mid-break. That nuance was closed by extending the sim-driven director test to spend gold mid-INTERMISSION and assert the summary still reports the pre-spend delta. All 3 models (gpt-5.4, gemini-3.1-pro-preview, claude-opus-4.8) agree the final diff is clean.

independent_grade.notes: The diff adds the Floor 4 arena HUD projection, rendering, lab probes, and deterministic coverage without introducing high-confidence correctness or policy issues. Focused unit tests, e2e coverage, typecheck, lint, and diff checks pass, and the changed state snapshots address the non-final break summary edge cases covered by the new tests.
